sincere.text: Once you showed me the foot traffic for Exit 4 on its own, I finally knew how to compare those three quotes.

partner.text: Page one's in. I'll pull the half-hour cup sales for the Exit 4 shop tomorrow morning.

sincere.text: I see regulars come in with their umbrellas still open all the time. Never thought that could help you pick when to run an ad.

partner.text: Page two's in. Ning says the evening shift sells the most when it rains. I'll ask her for the numbers on dry days.

sincere.text: Last time I bragged to my boss about how cheap the impressions were. One of my own coworkers saw the ad five times in one night.

partner.text: Page three's in. I marked the orders that came in after dinner that Friday last year.

sincere.text: When the MRT lightboxes got pulled, my first thought was, did we shoot that thirty-second spot for nothing?

partner.text: Page four's in. The client wants to know how many saw it. The branch wants confirmed bookings. I'll give each its own column.

sincere.text: The scan count looked pretty good last time. Then my boss asked which screen the scans came from, and I had nothing.

partner.text: Page five's in. Eighty plays a day by the elevators. I almost read that as eighty people.

sincere.text: When the chatbot recommended the place next door, I actually asked around at lunch to see where everyone gets their tea.

partner.text: Page six's in. I've got a column ready for the store manager. Tomorrow we'll see how many cups of the new drink they actually sell.

sincere.text: You really stood out there watching who looked up? I run a stall here and even I’ve never counted.

partner.text: Page seven's in. Six-ish under the covered sidewalk is the after-work crowd. Eight is the late-night food crowd. Got it.

sincere.text: Auntie Hsiu-chin buys her noodles by the case at the supermarket? I figured she ordered on her phone like the girl on the evening shift.

partner.text: Page eight's in. Auntie Hsiu-chin at noon, people waiting for egg crepes at night. I see why you ran the numbers separately.

sincere.text: That MRT quote was about to expire, and I nearly told you to sign it. Glad you showed me what else that money could buy.

partner.text: Page nine's in. Last time, short videos averaged seven views per person and reach still stalled. I'm keeping that number handy.
